title: Monday · north
logline: The drive to the San Juans on the doughnut spare and pure dread. Barnaby stays with Maria. The first drive without him.

panels.composition: Gully's lot, dawn. The Legacy, the doughnut still on. WOOD in the thrift-store wool suit, on a hanger in the back window. MARIA holding BARNABY. GULLY with a coffee for the road.

balloons.text: He'll be fine. He'll sleep. Go.

image.prompt: a thin man beside an old Subaru wagon at dawn with a wool suit hanging in its rear window and a tiny spare tire on one wheel, a practical woman holding a very old dog, a stocky man handing over a paper cup of coffee, clean ink

panels.composition: Interstate 5 north, the Legacy in the slow lane at fifty, trucks passing like weather. Wood's hands at ten and two. No dog in the passenger seat. The strip draws the empty seat.

image.prompt: an old Subaru wagon in the slow lane of an interstate with trucks blurring past, a thin man gripping the wheel, the passenger seat conspicuously empty, clean ink with a gray wash
image.notes: The empty passenger seat. The first drive without the dog.

panels.composition: A ferry. The Legacy on the car deck between two cars that cost more than the garage. Wood on the rail, the suit on now, sketchbook in his lap. Puget Sound.

characters.pose: on a ferry rail in the suit, sketchbook

image.prompt: a thin man in an ill-fitting wool suit at a ferry's rail with a sketchbook, an old Subaru on the car deck below between two expensive cars, Puget Sound in clear summer light, pale linen and cerulean wash

panels.composition: The island. A road through madrone. Ahead, through the trees: glass, cedar, a pavilion catching the light. The Legacy, small, approaching it on a toy tire.

image.prompt: an island road through madrone trees with a cedar-and-glass pavilion catching bright summer light ahead, an old Subaru wagon approaching small on a tiny spare tire, clear cerulean and linen watercolor, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Arc 3 opens. Four hundred miles at fifty. The empty seat. The pavilion ahead.
